covers: The VDP registers 0x00 to 0x1F of the Sega 315-5313, set by control words 0x80vv to 0x9Fvv and keyed 0x100 plus the register number so they do not overlap the port offsets, with registers 0x0B and up ignored while register 0x01 bit 2 is 0; keys 0x200 to 0x202 are the control words themselves

entries.name: VDP mode set 1
entries.description: Mode set register 1: horizontal interrupt enable, palette select and display disable.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x00 (control word 0x80vv): bit 4 enables HINT, bit 2 clear keeps only the low bit of each colour channel, bit 0 set blanks the display. Other bits are stored and unused. A write drops the interrupt line, or raises it 16 ticks later if a HINT is pending and bit 4 is set.

entries.name: VDP mode set 2
entries.description: Mode set register 2: display enable, vertical interrupt enable, DMA enable, 240 lines and Genesis mode.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x01 (control word 0x81vv): bit 6 display enable (0 blanks the display and VBLANK reads 1), bit 5 VINT enable, bit 4 DMA enable (0 disables all DMA), bit 3 240 lines from the next frame, bit 2 Genesis mode (0 ignores writes to registers 0x0B and up). Bits 7, 1 and 0 are stored and unused.

entries.name: Plane A table base
entries.description: Where plane A's name table sits in VRAM.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x02 (control word 0x82vv): bits 5 to 3 are address bits 15 to 13 of the plane A name table. Bits 7, 6 and 2 to 0 are stored and unused.

entries.name: Window table base
entries.description: Where the window plane's name table sits in VRAM.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x03 (control word 0x83vv): bits 5 to 1 are address bits 15 to 11 of the window name table; bit 1 is forced to 0 in 40-cell mode (register 0x0C bit 0 set). Bits 7, 6 and 0 are stored and unused.

entries.name: Plane B table base
entries.description: Where plane B's name table sits in VRAM.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x04 (control word 0x84vv): bits 2 to 0 are address bits 15 to 13 of the plane B name table. Bits 7 to 3 are stored and unused.

entries.name: Sprite table base
entries.description: Where the sprite attribute table sits in VRAM.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x05 (control word 0x85vv): bits 6 to 0 are address bits 15 to 9, bit 0 forced to 0 in 40-cell mode. Y, size and link come from an internal copy made by VRAM writes inside the table, not refreshed when this register moves; X and the pattern word come from VRAM. Bit 7 is stored and unused.

entries.name: VDP register 6
entries.description: Register 6, which MAME gives no meaning.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x06 (control word 0x86vv): stored and unused by MAME.

entries.name: Backdrop colour
entries.description: Which of the 64 colour RAM entries fills pixels no plane or sprite draws.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x07 (control word 0x87vv): bits 5 to 0 index the 64 CRAM entries drawn as the backdrop, also for every line while the display is disabled. Bits 7 and 6 are stored and unused.

entries.name: VDP register 8
entries.description: Register 8, which MAME gives no meaning.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x08 (control word 0x88vv): stored and unused by MAME.

entries.name: VDP register 9
entries.description: Register 9, which MAME gives no meaning.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x09 (control word 0x89vv): stored and unused by MAME.

entries.name: HINT line counter
entries.description: Reload value of the counter that times the horizontal interrupt.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x0A (control word 0x8Avv): the value (doubled when register 0x0C bits 2 and 1 are both set) reloads the counter on every line past 224 and whenever it passes 0. The counter falls once per line up to line 224, and passing 0 sets HINT pending.

entries.name: VDP mode set 3
entries.description: Mode set register 3: scroll modes of the two planes.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x0B (control word 0x8Bvv): bits 1 and 0 horizontal scroll (0 whole screen, 1 per line of each group of 8, 2 per 8-line cell, 3 per line), bit 2 vertical scroll (0 whole screen, 1 per 2-cell column). Bits 7 to 3 are stored and unused.

entries.name: VDP mode set 4
entries.description: Mode set register 4: screen width, interlace and shadow/highlight.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x0C (control word 0x8Cvv): bit 0 selects 40 cells (320 pixels) instead of 32, bit 3 shadow/highlight, bits 2 and 1 interlace (bit 1 gives the odd frame flag, both give double-height lines), latched at the next frame. Bit 7 is stored with no effect; bits 6 to 4 are stored and unused.

entries.name: Hscroll table base
entries.description: Where the horizontal scroll table sits in VRAM.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x0D (control word 0x8Dvv): bits 5 to 0 are address bits 15 to 10 of the table. Bits 7 and 6 are stored and unused.

entries.name: VDP register 14
entries.description: Register 14, which MAME gives no meaning.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x0E (control word 0x8Evv): stored and unused by MAME; ignored while register 0x01 bit 2 is 0.

entries.name: Auto increment
entries.description: The step added to the VRAM address after each data transfer.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x0F (control word 0x8Fvv): the 8-bit value is added to the address (16 bits, wrapping) after every data port read or write, DMA word, fill byte and copy byte.

entries.name: Plane size
entries.description: Width and height of the two scroll planes in cells.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x10 (control word 0x90vv): bits 1 to 0 width and bits 5 to 4 height (0 gives 32, 1 gives 64, 3 gives 128 cells); width 2 gives 64 by 1 and height 2 gives 64. Oversize pairs are cut: width 3 with height 1 gives 128 by 32, width 1 with height 3 gives 64 by 64.

entries.name: Window horizontal
entries.description: Horizontal split of the window plane.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x11 (control word 0x91vv): bits 4 to 0 give the split column in units of 2 cells (16 pixels), capped at the screen width; bit 7 set puts the window right of it, clear left of it. Bits 6 and 5 are stored and unused.

entries.name: Window vertical
entries.description: Vertical split of the window plane.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x12 (control word 0x92vv): bits 4 to 0 give the split line in units of 8 lines; bit 7 set puts the window below it, clear above it, and a line inside it is window across the full width. Bits 6 and 5 are stored and unused.

entries.name: DMA length low
entries.description: Low byte of the DMA length.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x13 (control word 0x93vv): low byte of the length: words for a 68k transfer, bytes for a fill or a copy. A 68k length of 0 or 0x8000 moves 0x7FFF words (bit 15 is dropped) and a copy of 0 moves nothing. MAME zeroes it after a 68k transfer and a fill, not after a copy.

entries.name: DMA length high
entries.description: High byte of the DMA length.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x14 (control word 0x94vv): high byte of the length whose low byte is register 0x13. Cleared with register 0x13 after a 68k transfer or a fill.

entries.name: DMA source low
entries.description: Low byte of the DMA source address.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x15 (control word 0x95vv): for a 68k transfer, source byte address bits 8 to 1 (three registers times 2); readable sources are 0 to 0x3FFFFF and 0xE00000 to 0xFFFFFF, any other gives random words. For a copy, the VRAM source byte address low byte.

entries.name: DMA source middle
entries.description: Middle byte of the DMA source address.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x16 (control word 0x96vv): for a 68k transfer, source byte address bits 16 to 9; for a copy, the VRAM source byte address high byte. After a 68k transfer registers 0x15 to 0x17 hold the end address shifted right by 1; a VSRAM transfer stopped past address 0x80 leaves them unchanged.

entries.name: DMA source high/type
entries.description: High source bits and the DMA type.
entries.behaviour: VDP register 0x17 (control word 0x97vv): bit 7 clear is a 68k transfer, with bits 6 to 0 as source address bits 23 to 17; bits 7 and 6 equal to 10 is a fill; both set is a VRAM copy, which ignores the other bits. The type is read only when a second control word has code bit 5.

entries.name: Registers 0x18 to 0x1F
entries.description: The eight register numbers above the used ones.
entries.behaviour: VDP registers 0x18 to 0x1F (control words 0x98vv to 0x9Fvv): stored and unused by MAME, and ignored while register 0x01 bit 2 is 0. A control word with bit 13 set (0xA0vv and up) logs a register error and writes the register number masked to 5 bits.

entries.name: register-set word
entries.description: The control word that sets a VDP register.
entries.behaviour: Not a register: the word 0x8000 | (register << 8) | value, taken only when no command is pending. It stores the low byte in the register, clears the code and the address to 0 and cancels an armed fill. Registers 0x0B to 0x1F are ignored while register 0x01 bit 2 is 0.

entries.name: command first word
entries.description: The first control word of a VRAM, CRAM or VSRAM command.
entries.behaviour: Not a register: any word whose bits 15:14 are not 10, taken when no command is pending. Bits 15:14 are code bits 1:0 and bits 13:0 address bits 13:0; code and address are recomputed at once, with code bits 5:2 and address bits 15:14 still from the previous second word. The next control write is the second word.

entries.name: command second word
entries.description: The second control word that completes a command.
entries.behaviour: Taken after a first word whatever its bits 15:14 (not a register). Bits 7:4 are code bits 5:2, bits 1:0 address bits 15:14, the rest ignored. Code 0 VRAM read, 1 VRAM write, 3 CRAM write, 4 VSRAM read, 5 VSRAM write, 8 CRAM read sets what the data port does; bit 5 starts a DMA.
